description: This PHP source file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'EmploymentContractDao' within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for accessing and persisting employment contract data related to employees.

classes.name: EmploymentContractDao
classes.description: A DAO class for employment contracts, extending the base DAO to provide methods for retrieving and saving employment contract entities.

methods.name: getEmploymentContractByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an EmpContract entity associated with a given employee number using a query builder.

methods.name: saveEmploymentContract
methods.description: Persists an EmpContract entity to the database and returns it.
